scope.purpose: Decide whether an existing external comparator can supply a claim-eligible numeric SOTA Target without borrowing cross-contract evidence.
scope.bounded_claim: No candidate present in the frozen repository evidence or the primary-source delta audit through the source cutoff is eligible or can be upgraded by metadata-only repair.
scope.not_claimed: This audit does not prove that a future independently implemented and audited same-contract comparator is impossible.

contract.authorized_query_input: complete binary mask on the single canonical official reference frame plus reference calibration
contract.query_boundary: frozen field plus Authorized Query Input and target Output Request Metadata; no captured or rendered RGB, external vision model, mask cache, or target mask
contract.scored_frames: every non-reference annotated frame; the reference frame is not scored
contract.aggregation: unweighted frame mean within each scene, then unweighted macro over all nine scenes
contract.required_proof: runtime-compliance-proof-v1 PASS over the complete Exact Row Authority
contract.comparator_role: external comparator rather than the current RADIO-GS method

resolution.reason: Every external candidate fails at least one immutable contract dimension and lacks a PASS Runtime Compliance Proof; RADIO-GS rows cannot serve as their own external SOTA comparator.
resolution.future_unblock_condition: Produce a new external same-contract execution with a complete Exact Row Authority and runtime-compliance-proof-v1 PASS. That would create a new evidence identity and a new explicit target decision; it would not upgrade any row audited here.
resolution.planning_consequence: Keep the SPIn-NeRF numeric SOTA Target absent and fail closed. Do not substitute 93.7200449592385, 94.57777777777778, 93.8, or a RADIO-GS result.
